messages:
Priya Patel: Hey team — customer acct_9a3b reports Console shows $200 promo credits under Billing > Credits, but API usage is still being billed. They provided screenshots and said charges appeared today. Can we triage?
Alex Kim: Thanks Priya. Quick checks: is this hosted API (public Redwood API) or Dedicated/Private?
Priya Patel: Hosted. Customer using API key tied to org: org_77f. Billing page shows credits on org_77f. API usage appears on the invoice for billing_account ba_3m and credits not applied.
Alex Kim: Ok that smells like org vs billing_account mapping mismatch. Ask customer for: account id, billing_account id (if available), one sample request id (X-Request-Id from response headers) and the timestamp. Also ask whether they created the promo in console or got an email grant.
Priya Patel: Requested those. Customer returned: account id acct_9a3b, billing_account ba_3m, sample X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d, timestamp 2026-03-15T14:12:08Z. Promo was applied via Console
